description.p: HushHour is a distraction-free Markdown editor. The page is the whole window: no toolbar, no title bar, just your text in a comfortable column that reflows as you zoom.

A spotlight dims everything but the paragraph or sentence you are writing, the caret line can be anchored mid-screen so the page scrolls under it, and a frosted-glass mode lets the desktop show through. Light, sepia and dark themes and three bundled writing fonts come with it.
A live preview shows the formatted document beside the editor or in place of it, updating as you type.
Typing sounds and background music keep you company: gentle key sounds, bundled instrumental loops, generated soundscapes (rain, a night of crickets, a train, a breeze, a drone), or your own tracks.

description.p: Easier to read on standard-density monitors: the menu and dialogs use Lato Regular instead of Lato Light, and secondary text and the status bar have more contrast and a slightly larger size.

Markdown preview: show the formatted document beside the editor or on its own (Ctrl+Shift+P cycles editor, split and preview), updated live as you type and scrolled to follow the caret. Links in the preview open in the browser.
Shared crate: undo and redo availability is exposed for the ports. No change in behaviour.
New screenshots; no change in behaviour.
The platform-independent part of the app (Markdown scanning, statistics, undo history, soundscapes) is now a separate crate shared with the iPad version. No change in behaviour.
The app is now called HushHour, with a new icon. Settings and the recent-files list from Inkpad are carried over.

Typing and Enter are now held to the same 20 MB document limit as pasting and opening, so a document HushHour lets you build is always one it can reopen; the unsaved-changes dialog's Enter key is covered by a test.

Verification fixes: "Don't save" now covers only the text it was answered for, so edits made while a file is still being chosen or read are never lost; the music decoder's memory stays bounded however fast it decodes; Save As groups undo like Save; a failed recent-files update is reported alongside a successful save; the undo budget holds while typing; pasting over a selection counts what it replaces; tests and diagnostic runs write nothing to the configuration directory.

Follow-up audit fixes: saving never falls back to overwriting in place and uses exclusively created temporary files; Open requests are identified so a cancelled "Don't save" cannot let another load replace edited text; Cancel disarms a pending save-and-quit; every exit runs the same cleanup; the music decoder is cancellable and gives up on empty or broken files; linear Markdown scanning in every case; bounded document, paste and undo sizes; keyboard choices in the unsaved-changes dialog; tests run in CI.

Review fixes: saves are atomic and never mark newer edits as saved; closing, opening and New always protect unsaved changes; muting no longer loses the music; file decoding moved off the audio thread; licence texts ship with the app; fonts are upstream releases; release AppImages are built for glibc 2.35.
Asks before closing, opening or starting a new document with unsaved changes. Recent files in the menu. New fonts: IBM Plex Mono, IBM Plex Sans and Literata.
